ZERRA
Rethink Waste. Reconnect with Earth.

Welcome to Zerra

Reconnect with what sustains you.

Zerra connects everyday choices with Mother Earth, other living beings, our communities, and the consequences of what we do. Start with what would help you now. You can change it anytime.

One principle comes first: use what you already have before buying something new.

Choose the practical approach that fits your circumstances.

The responsibility to care is shared. The methods can differ by access, housing, health, time, and resources.

♡
Living Earth

Refuse → Reduce → Reuse → Repair → Repurpose → Share → Compost → Recycle → Dispose responsibly.

The Life Framework

Four values for a connected life.

LIFE is Zerra’s ethical lens for rebuilding a conscious relationship with Mother Earth, other living beings, communities, belongings, food, and self. The four values work together; none is a score, purity test, or excuse to ignore health, safety, accessibility, or material reality.

Carry three questions into every decision

  1. 1. What is my relationship with this?
  2. 2. What is the most responsible practical action available to me?
  3. 3. How can I return, restore, share, or give back?

The LIFE Framework and Zerra’s four responsibilities are Michael’s creator framework. Zerra does not attribute them to the Hopi or broadly to Indigenous peoples without specific, reliable evidence.

History, ethics, and the danger of familiarity

When Harm Becomes Normal

A practice being legal, traditional, profitable, familiar, or socially accepted does not by itself establish that the practice is ethical.

This is not a claim that animal agriculture, consumer waste, or environmental damage is identical to human atrocities.

The victims, histories, circumstances, and forms of suffering are different. The comparison concerns a recurring social mechanism: people can become accustomed to harmful systems and build language, institutions, laws, habits, and economic interests around them.

01

Normalization is not justification.

History contains practices defended or tolerated within their societies and later condemned, restricted, or abolished. Their familiarity did not make them defensible.

Enslavement

People treated as property

Enslavement was embedded in law and major economic systems for generations. Historical acceptance did not make ownership of human beings morally defensible.

Library of Congress ↗

Child labor

Dangerous work became ordinary

Industrial child labor placed children in factories, mills, mines, and street work. Reform came despite defenses involving income, industry, and established practice.

Library of Congress ↗

Forced assimilation

Native children separated from culture

Federal Indian boarding schools separated Native children from families and sought to suppress languages, religions, names, clothing, and cultural practices.

National Park Service ↗

Human experimentation

Research without meaningful consent

The U.S. Public Health Service study at Tuskegee continued without informed consent and without appropriate treatment even after effective treatment was available.

National Library of Medicine ↗
02

How harmful systems become ordinary.

No single mechanism explains every case, but the same kinds of defenses appear repeatedly.

Tradition

“We have always done it.”

Legality

“It is allowed, therefore it is acceptable.”

Economics

“Jobs and livelihoods depend on it.”

Distance

The harmed person, animal, community, or ecosystem becomes invisible to the beneficiary.

Language

Technical or commercial words can make physical realities easier to ignore.

Institutions

Responsibility can be distributed until nobody feels accountable for the whole system.

03

Apply the question consistently.

The lesson is not that every accepted practice is secretly evil. It is that acceptance alone cannot settle the moral question.

Who or what bears the harm, and are tradition, convenience, price, legality, or profit sufficient reasons to continue it when realistic alternatives exist?

Ask this of disposable consumption, planned obsolescence, extraction, pollution, exploitative labor, animal use, and the ways costs are shifted onto communities, future generations, and Mother Earth.

Examine animal use in Go Vegan ↗

Reconnect

Remember the relationships behind everyday life.

Waste begins long before a bin. Reconnect explores origins, dependence, responsibility, reciprocity, enoughness, place, and the movement from doing less harm toward restoring what sustains life.

The four responsibilities

The Life Framework in practice.

Food, Seeds & Soil

Use the food. Save what can grow. Return what remains.

A seed is not automatically food, viable planting stock, or appropriate for the place where you live. Start with the plant, its source, and your circumstances—then choose a respectful path.

Never scatter unknown seeds. Do not plant saved seeds in parks, roadsides, public land, or unmanaged natural areas. Check permission, invasive-species guidance, disease restrictions, and local growing rules.

Return nutrients

Choose the compost system that actually fits.

Give Back & Restore

Care for a place with whatever access you have.

Local knowledge matters. Verify species, climate, watershed, permission, housing rules, and ordinances through official local sources. A lawn-height rule is not automatically the same as a rule for intentional gardens or registered habitat.

Discover

See the relationships behind everyday life.

Find practical guidance while learning where things come from, what sustains them, what happens after use, and how you can return or give back.

Your data

Zerra stores your recommendation path, Journey progress, saved items, actions, and theme locally in this browser.

About Zerra

A companion for reconnecting with what sustains us.

Zerra helps people use less, care for what already exists, return materials responsibly, restore living systems, and understand the ripple effects of everyday life through Longevity, Integrity, Flourishing, and Equilibrium.

Zerra and Go Vegan remain separate tools. When a question centers animals or animal-derived products, Go Vegan provides the deeper animal relationship and plant-based guidance.

Visit Go Vegan ↗

    reconnectModules: [
      {id:'disconnection',number:'01',title:'The Disconnection',opening:'Waste is not only a material problem. It grows when we lose sight of where things come from, who and what made them possible, and where they go after us.',example:'A meal can appear as a package and a receipt while hiding soil, water, seed, labor, transport, other living beings, and the discarded remainder.',deeper:'Reconnection begins by making those relationships visible again. Awareness is not guilt. It is the information needed to act with integrity.',prompts:['What ordinary thing do I use without knowing its story?','Which relationship becomes visible when I slow down and look?'],action:'Choose one thing you use today and trace its life before and after you.',actionQuery:'where things come from',attribution:'Zerra creator framework. The material examples should be checked against reliable product, ecological, labor, and local-system sources.'},
      {id:'mother-earth',number:'02',title:'Mother Earth as Relationship, Not Commodity',opening:'Mother Earth is not merely a poetic name for raw materials. It names the living relationships that make every human life possible.',example:'Soil is not dirt waiting to be used. It is a living community shaped by organisms, water, air, minerals, decay, and time.',deeper:'A relationship asks more than how much we can extract. It asks how we receive, care, return, repair, and remain accountable to the conditions that sustain life.',prompts:['Where do I experience Earth as a relationship rather than scenery?','What would care look like in that place?'],action:'Spend ten attentive minutes with the land, water, plants, or wildlife where you live before deciding what it needs.',actionQuery:'observe local ecosystem',attribution:'Zerra creator framework. “Mother Earth” is used here as Zerra’s relational language, not attributed to a single Indigenous nation or tradition.'},
      {id:'interdependence',number:'03',title:'Interdependence',opening:'Nothing sustains itself alone. Bodies, households, communities, species, and ecosystems exist through relationships of dependence and exchange.',example:'A bell pepper depends on seed, soil life, water, sunlight, pollination, climate, growers, transport, and care in the kitchen.',deeper:'Interdependence challenges the fiction that consumption is a private act. Our choices enter living, social, and material systems that extend beyond us.',prompts:['What made my last meal possible?','Who or what carries costs that I rarely see?'],action:'Name five relationships behind one food or object, then care for it accordingly.',actionQuery:'interdependence',attribution:'Zerra synthesis of established ecological and social-system concepts; factual examples require source-specific support.'},
      {id:'origins',number:'04',title:'Where Things Come From',opening:'Every object has an origin story: living sources, extracted materials, land, water, energy, skill, and labor.',example:'A cotton shirt begins long before a store—with seed, soil, water, farming, fiber processing, dyeing, sewing, transport, and human hands.',deeper:'Knowing origins changes the question from “Can I replace this?” to “How can I honor what is already here and reduce the need to take again?”',prompts:['Which material in my home do I understand least?','Would knowing its origin change how I use or discard it?'],action:'Look up the primary materials and care instructions for one item you already own.',actionQuery:'material origins',attribution:'Factual origin chains must cite current primary, technical, or peer-reviewed sources and distinguish general patterns from a specific product.'},
      {id:'enoughness',number:'05',title:'Enoughness and the Consumption Machine',opening:'Enoughness means recognizing when a real need has been met. It is an alternative to systems that survive by continually manufacturing dissatisfaction.',example:'A usable phone can be made to feel obsolete by fashion, marketing, software pressure, or the promise that a newer object will change how we feel.',deeper:'Enoughness is not deprivation or romanticized poverty. It respects safety, accessibility, joy, and genuine need while resisting unnecessary extraction and accumulation.',prompts:['Where do I already have enough?','What feeling am I asking a purchase to create?'],action:'Pause one nonessential purchase for seven days and use, repair, borrow, or go without first.',actionQuery:'purchase pause',attribution:'Zerra creator framework informed by anti-consumerist and sufficiency traditions; named cultural or scholarly claims require specific attribution.'},
      {id:'ripple-effects',number:'06',title:'Responsibility and Ripple Effects',opening:'Every action carries direct and indirect effects, including effects we cannot fully measure or predict.',example:'Throwing away edible food loses the food itself and also the land, water, energy, labor, transport, and opportunity bound up in it.',deeper:'Responsibility does not require perfect knowledge. It requires honest attention, proportionate care, correction when we learn more, and refusal to hide uncertainty.',prompts:['What consequence of one routine have I treated as someone else’s problem?','What is one effect I can responsibly reduce?'],action:'Map one routine as before, during, and after. Change the clearest avoidable harm.',actionQuery:'ripple effects',attribution:'The four responsibilities are the creator’s Life Framework. Quantified impact claims require a defensible method and cited evidence.'},
      {id:'reciprocity',number:'07',title:'Reciprocity',opening:'Reciprocity asks what we return to the relationships from which we receive.',example:'Food scraps can become contamination in a landfill stream or, where a safe system exists, nutrients returned through compost.',deeper:'Return is not a license to consume without limit. It follows refusal, reduction, continued use, care, repair, sharing, and preservation.',prompts:['What do I receive regularly without giving back?','What form of return is actually useful rather than symbolic?'],action:'Choose one grounded return: share food, compost appropriately, restore soil, offer a skill, or care for a place.',actionQuery:'give back restore',attribution:'Zerra creator framework. Cultural teachings about reciprocity must be attributed to their specific living peoples and appropriate sources.'},
      {id:'future-generations',number:'08',title:'Future Generations',opening:'Longevity asks whether today’s choices preserve the conditions required for lives beyond our own.',example:'Saving suitable seeds, maintaining fertile soil, teaching repair, and protecting clean water keep knowledge and possibility available.',deeper:'Future responsibility includes children already living, people not yet born, other species, and the ecological communities that cannot represent themselves in our institutions.',prompts:['What am I maintaining that someone else may depend on?','Which skill or resource should not end with me?'],action:'Teach, document, save, repair, or share one useful thing so it can continue beyond you.',actionQuery:'future generations',attribution:'The application of Longevity is part of the creator’s Life Framework; external cultural claims require specific attribution.'},
      {id:'place',number:'09',title:'Relationship with Place',opening:'There is no universal zero-waste routine detached from place. Climate, watershed, species, housing, infrastructure, law, and community shape responsible action.',example:'A yard, balcony, apartment, rural property, and shared building offer different safe possibilities for composting, habitat, food growing, and water care.',deeper:'Place-based practice begins with observation and authoritative local knowledge. It avoids scattering unknown seeds, importing invasive species, or treating one city’s rules as universal.',prompts:['What watershed, soil, and living community am I part of?','Which local rule or service do I need to verify?'],action:'Identify your watershed and one official local source for waste, growing, or habitat guidance.',actionQuery:'local official guidance',attribution:'Local claims must include jurisdiction, date, and an official source. Indigenous place knowledge requires nation-specific attribution and respectful use.'},

    challenges: [
      {id:'c1', title:'Use What You Have', duration:'7 days', description:'Pause unnecessary purchases and intentionally use, finish, maintain, or repurpose what you already own.', steps:['Pick three categories where you tend to buy duplicates.','Check what you already own before every purchase in those categories.','Use unfinished products and supplies first.','At the end of the week, note what you did not need to buy.']},
      {id:'c2', title:'7-Day Waste Awareness', duration:'7 days', description:'Observe the waste your routine creates so future changes are based on reality.', steps:['Notice your trash and recycling each day.','Write down recurring items.','Notice food waste separately.','Choose one recurring item to address next week.']},
      {id:'c3', title:'Repair Before Replace', duration:'14 days', description:'When something fails, investigate safe repair or maintenance before defaulting to replacement.', steps:['Create a short repair list.','Start with safe, low-risk repairs.','Research parts or professional repair for harder items.','Replace only when repair is unsafe, impractical, unavailable, or no longer sensible.']},
      {id:'c4', title:'Food Waste Week', duration:'7 days', description:'Build meals around food that needs to be used and learn what is repeatedly going uneaten.', steps:['Create an eat-first zone.','Check food before shopping.','Plan flexible meals around perishables.','Freeze suitable surplus before it spoils.']},
      {id:'c5', title:'Secondhand First', duration:'30 days', description:'For non-urgent purchases, check borrowing and secondhand options before buying new.', steps:['Define the need.','Check what you own.','Consider borrowing.','Check appropriate secondhand options.','Buy new only when it remains the sensible choice.']},
      {id:'c6', title:'Compost Starter', duration:'14 days', description:'Learn and establish a compost route appropriate to your living situation.', steps:['Choose your compost route.','Learn accepted materials for that exact system.','Set up collection that is easy to maintain.','Observe moisture, odor, pests, or collection requirements and adjust.']},
      {id:'c7', title:'Disposable-Free Day', duration:'1 day', description:'See how many common disposables you can avoid using things you already own, without turning the challenge into a shopping trip.', steps:['Notice likely disposable situations before leaving home.','Pack only useful reusable items you already own.','Refuse unnecessary extras.','Review what was easy and what was unrealistic.']},
      {id:'c8', title:'Grow Something', duration:'30+ days', description:'Grow one edible plant or useful herb appropriate to your conditions and learn from the process.', steps:['Choose a suitable plant.','Learn its basic needs.','Use safe existing containers if appropriate.','Observe and care for it consistently.','Harvest when ready and record what you learned.']},
      {id:'c9', title:'No-Buy Pause', duration:'7 days', description:'Practice distinguishing needs from impulses without turning the challenge into deprivation.', steps:['Choose one nonessential purchase category to pause.','When you want something, write down the need it would solve.','Check what you own, borrowing, repair, or substitution first.','Review the list after seven days and decide what still matters.']},
      {id:'c10', title:'Pantry First', duration:'7 days', description:'Use overlooked pantry, refrigerator, and freezer food before adding unnecessary groceries.', steps:['Take a quick food inventory.','Identify items that should be used soon.','Plan several meals around existing ingredients.','Buy only the missing essentials needed to make the plan work.']},
      {id:'c11', title:'Freezer Rescue', duration:'7 days', description:'Make frozen food visible again and prevent useful food from becoming forgotten storage.', steps:['Inventory the freezer.','Label unclear items when you can identify them safely.','Move older useful food into an eat-soon group.','Use several items during the week before adding more.']},
      {id:'c12', title:'Refuse the Extras', duration:'7 days', description:'Reduce unnecessary items at the point where they enter your life.', steps:['Notice recurring extras such as bags, utensils, receipts, samples, or promotional items.','Decline what you genuinely do not need.','Keep necessary accessibility, hygiene, and safety items.','At week end, identify the easiest refusal habit to keep.']},
      {id:'c13', title:'Reusable From Home', duration:'7 days', description:'Use suitable reusable items you already own for routines that commonly create disposable waste.', steps:['Choose two recurring disposable situations.','Find an existing reusable option that actually works.','Keep it convenient enough to use consistently.','Do not buy a new reusable merely to complete the challenge.']},
      {id:'c14', title:'Clothing Care Week', duration:'7 days', description:'Extend garment life through better use, cleaning, storage, and simple maintenance.', steps:['Choose several frequently worn garments.','Follow their care needs instead of automatically using the harshest wash or dry routine.','Address one stain, loose button, small tear, or storage problem.','Identify one clothing-care habit worth keeping.']},
      {id:'c15', title:'Mend Something', duration:'7 days', description:'Complete one safe, realistic clothing or textile repair instead of discarding the item.', steps:['Choose a repair within your skill level.','Identify the simplest suitable method.','Use supplies you already have when practical.','Complete the repair or identify a local repair option if it exceeds your ability.']},
      {id:'c16', title:'Maintenance Week', duration:'7 days', description:'Prevent avoidable replacement by completing neglected household maintenance.', steps:['List five maintenance tasks.','Prioritize safety-critical instructions and manufacturer guidance.','Complete at least two appropriate tasks.','Schedule anything that requires a qualified professional.']},
      {id:'c17', title:'Borrow Before Buy', duration:'14 days', description:'Test shared access for things you need only occasionally.', steps:['Identify one upcoming occasional-use need.','Check friends, family, libraries, tool libraries, rental, or sharing options where appropriate.','Borrow or rent when it genuinely fits.','Return shared items clean, complete, and on time.']},
      {id:'c18', title:'Declutter Responsibly', duration:'14 days', description:'Move unwanted belongings onward thoughtfully instead of simply shifting everything into the trash.', steps:['Choose one small area rather than the whole home.','Separate keep, repair, reuse, share, donate, sell, recycle, and disposal routes.','Match useful items with realistic recipients.','Dispose of unusable material through appropriate routes.']},
      {id:'c19', title:'Local Recycling Reality Check', duration:'7 days', description:'Replace recycling assumptions with the actual rules of the system that serves you.', steps:['Find your official local recycling guidance.','Compare it with what your household currently puts in recycling.','Remove recurring contaminants or unsupported materials.','Create a simple reminder for confusing items.']},
      {id:'c20', title:'Special Waste Check', duration:'7 days', description:'Identify safer end-of-life routes for materials that should not automatically enter household trash or recycling.', steps:['Choose three relevant items such as batteries, electronics, paint, medication, oil, or bulbs.','Find official or reputable local instructions.','Store items safely until the proper route is available.','Use one appropriate collection or drop-off route if practical.']},
      {id:'c21', title:'Water Awareness Week', duration:'7 days', description:'Learn where household water is being used before deciding what changes are worthwhile.', steps:['Notice showers, faucets, toilets, laundry, dishes, and outdoor use.','Check for obvious leaks or running fixtures.','Choose one behavior change that does not compromise hygiene or health.','Record what was practical enough to continue.']},
      {id:'c22', title:'Energy Awareness Week', duration:'7 days', description:'Understand everyday household energy use and identify avoidable waste without sacrificing safety.', steps:['Review major heating, cooling, hot-water, lighting, appliance, and electronics routines.','Look for equipment running unnecessarily.','Choose one no-cost or low-effort improvement.','Avoid unsafe heating, cooling, electrical, or ventilation practices.']},
      {id:'c23', title:'Car-Trip Reduction', duration:'7 days', description:'Replace or combine a few vehicle trips when safe, accessible, and practical.', steps:['Review your likely trips for the week.','Choose trips that could be walked, cycled, combined, shared, or handled by transit.','Do not trade safety or accessibility for challenge completion.','Keep only the alternatives that work in real life.']},
      {id:'c24', title:'Walkable Errand', duration:'1 day', description:'Complete one suitable local errand without a dedicated car trip when conditions allow.', steps:['Choose a realistic destination.','Check route, weather, daylight, accessibility, and carrying needs.','Walk, cycle, use transit, or combine the errand with another trip.','Skip or modify the challenge when conditions are unsafe.']},
      {id:'c25', title:'Cleaning Simplification', duration:'7 days', description:'Reduce duplicate cleaning products and routines while continuing to follow safety and product instructions.', steps:['Inventory the cleaners you already have.','Identify overlapping products.','Use appropriate existing products before buying more.','Never mix chemicals unless the product directions explicitly say it is safe.']},

    buildSearchIndexes() {
      const normalize = value => String(value || '').toLowerCase().replace(/[^a-z0-9]+/g, ' ').trim();
      const stableHash = value => {
        let hash = 2166136261;
        for (const char of value) hash = Math.imul(hash ^ char.charCodeAt(0), 16777619);
        return (hash >>> 0).toString(36);
      };
      const collectionFor = item => {
        const text = normalize(`${item.category} ${item.title}`);
        if (/food|cook|preserv|compost|soil|garden|grow|seed/.test(text)) return 'food-soil';
        if (/repair|maintain|mend|care|reuse|repurpose/.test(text)) return 'care-repair';
        if (/community|share|borrow|donat|mutual|neighbor/.test(text)) return 'community';
        if (/resource|guide|research|safety|local rule/.test(text)) return 'guides';
        if (/refuse|reduce|consum|buy less|enough/.test(text)) return 'refuse-reduce';
        return 'everyday';
      };
      this.exploreItems.forEach(i => {
        i.collectionId = i.collectionId || collectionFor(i);
        i._search = `${i.title} ${i.summary} ${i.category} ${(i.steps||[]).join(' ')}`.toLowerCase();
      });
      this.disposalItems.forEach(i => {
        i._name = String(i.name || '').toLowerCase();
        i._keywords = (i.keywords || []).map(k => k.toLowerCase());
      });
      this.swapItems.forEach(i => {
        if (/and the waste or consumption associated with replacing or using it routinely/i.test(i.description || '')) {
          const category = this.swapCategories.find(category=>category.id===i.categoryId)?.name || 'everyday life';
          i.description = `${i.name} within ${category.toLowerCase()}: compare using up what exists, reducing demand, extending useful life, sharing, and responsible return before buying a replacement.`;
        }
        i._search = `${i.name} ${i.description} ${(i.keywords||[]).join(' ')} ${(i.tags||[]).join(' ')}`.toLowerCase();
      });
      const guideByName = new Map();
      this.itemGuideItems.forEach(i => {
        i._search = `${i.name} ${i.summary||''} ${i.area||''} ${i.category||''} ${(i.keywords||[]).join(' ')}`.toLowerCase();
        const key = normalize(i.name);
        const canonical = guideByName.get(key);
        if (canonical) {
          i.canonicalId = canonical.id;
          canonical.aliasIds.push(i.id);
          canonical.keywords = [...new Set([...(canonical.keywords || []), ...(i.keywords || [])])];
          canonical.disposalIds = [...new Set([...(canonical.disposalIds || []), ...(i.disposalIds || [])])];
          if (!canonical.swapItemId && i.swapItemId) canonical.swapItemId = i.swapItemId;
        } else {
          i.canonicalId = i.id;
          i.aliasIds = [];
          guideByName.set(key, i);
        }
      });
      this.canonicalItemGuideItems = [...guideByName.values()];
      this.swapAlternativesByItem = {};
      const strategyById = new Map();
      this.swapAlternatives.forEach(a => {
        a.strategyId = `strategy-${stableHash(normalize(`${a.type} ${a.description}`))}`;
        if (!strategyById.has(a.strategyId)) strategyById.set(a.strategyId, {id:a.strategyId,type:a.type,description:a.description});
        (this.swapAlternativesByItem[a.itemId] ||= []).push(a);
      });
      this.alternativeStrategies = [...strategyById.values()];
      this.swapCategoryById = Object.fromEntries(this.swapCategories.map(c => [c.id,c]));
      this.swapAreaById = Object.fromEntries(this.swapAreas.map(a => [a.id,a]));
      this.swapItemsByCategory = {};
      this.swapItems.forEach(i => {
        (this.swapItemsByCategory[i.categoryId] ||= []).push(i);
      });
      this.knowledgeStats = {
        subjects: this.canonicalItemGuideItems.length,
        aliasesConsolidated: this.itemGuideItems.length - this.canonicalItemGuideItems.length,
        sharedStrategies: this.alternativeStrategies.length,
        guides: this.exploreItems.length,
        disposal: this.disposalItems.length
      };
    },

    init() {
  this.swapAlternativesByItem = {};
  this.swapAlternatives.forEach(a => {
    (this.swapAlternativesByItem[a.itemId] ||= []).push(a);
  });
  this.buildSearchIndexes();
  this.load();
  // Zerra now opens directly into Today. Personalization remains optional in Settings.
  this.profile.onboarded = true;
  document.documentElement.dataset.theme = this.theme;
  this.journeyDoneSet = new Set(this.journeyDone);
  this.actionForm.date = this.todayISO();
  this.computeSwapCounts();

  // Verify localStorage is available
  try {
    const testKey = 'zerra-storage-test';
    window.localStorage.setItem(testKey, '1');
    if (window.localStorage.getItem(testKey) !== '1') {
      console.warn('Zerra localStorage test failed: writes are not readable.');
    }
    window.localStorage.removeItem(testKey);
  } catch (e) {
    console.warn('Zerra localStorage is unavailable in this runtime.', e);
  }

  // Watch all relevant state keys to auto-save on change
  const persistWatchedState = () => this.persist();
  [
    'profile.path', 'profile.onboarded',
    'journeyDone', 'saved', 'impact', 'activity', 'reflections', 'theme',
    'view', 'globalSearch', 'exploreSearch',
    'filters.category', 'filters.path', 'filters.difficulty',
    'filters.cost', 'filters.time', 'filters.sort',
    'disposalSearch', 'journeyArea', 'impactFilter',
    'swapsView', 'swapsSearch', 'swapsFilter', 'swapsPriority',
    'swapsSelectedArea', 'swapsSelectedCategory', 'swapsSelectedItem',
    'itemGuideSearch', 'itemGuideArea', 'itemGuideCategory',
    'itemGuideSelected',
    'foodCycleSearch', 'selectedSeedId', 'growingContext',
    'actionForm.type', 'actionForm.quantity', 'actionForm.note', 'actionForm.date'
  ].forEach(key => this.$watch(key, persistWatchedState));

  // Save on page hide/unload
  window.addEventListener('pagehide', persistWatchedState);
  window.addEventListener('beforeunload', persistWatchedState);
  document.addEventListener('visibilitychange', () => {
    if (document.visibilityState === 'hidden') persistWatchedState();
  });

  // ★★★ FORCE AN INITIAL SAVE ★★★
  // This ensures the current state is persisted even if the user does nothing.
  this.persist();
    },

    computeSwapCounts() {
      // Count categories per area
      this.swapAreas.forEach(area => {
        area.categoryCount = this.swapCategories.filter(c => c.areaId === area.id).length;
      });
      // Count items per category
      this.swapCategories.forEach(cat => {
        cat.itemCount = this.swapItems.filter(i => i.categoryId === cat.id).length;
      });
      // Count alternatives per item
      this.swapItems.forEach(item => {
        item.alternativeCount = this.swapAlternatives.filter(a => a.itemId === item.id).length;
        const cat = this.swapCategories.find(c => c.id === item.categoryId);
        item.categoryName = cat ? cat.name : '';
      });
    },

    load() {
  let zerraApp = null;
  try {
    zerraApp = window.localStorage.getItem('zerra-app');
  } catch (e) {
    console.warn('Zerra could not access local storage.', e);
  }
  if (zerraApp) {
    try {
      const data = JSON.parse(zerraApp);
      console.log('✅ Zerra data loaded:', data); // optional

      if (data.profile) {
        this.profile = {
          onboarded: true,
          path: ['modern','balanced','earthbound'].includes(data.profile.path) ? data.profile.path : 'balanced'
        };
      }
      if (Array.isArray(data.journeyDone)) this.journeyDone = data.journeyDone;
      if (Array.isArray(data.saved)) this.saved = data.saved;
      if (Array.isArray(data.impact)) this.impact = data.impact;
      if (Array.isArray(data.activity)) this.activity = data.activity;
      if (Array.isArray(data.reflections)) this.reflections = data.reflections;
      if (data.theme === 'dark' || data.theme === 'light') this.theme = data.theme;

      // Restore UI state
      if (data.ui) {
        const ui = data.ui;
        const legacyViews = {home:'home',explore:'explore',disposal:'disposal',journey:'journey',impact:'impact',swaps:'swaps',saved:'saved'};
        this.view = legacyViews[ui.view] || 'home';
        if (ui.view === 'disposal') this.disposalSearch = ui.disposalSearch || '';
        this.globalSearch = ui.globalSearch || '';
        this.exploreSearch = ui.exploreSearch || '';
        if (ui.filters) this.filters = { ...this.filters, ...ui.filters };
        this.disposalSearch = ui.disposalSearch || '';
        this.journeyArea = ui.journeyArea || '';
        this.impactFilter = ui.impactFilter || '';
        this.foodCycleSearch = ui.foodCycleSearch || '';
        this.selectedSeedId = this.seedProfiles.some(profile=>profile.id===ui.selectedSeedId) ? ui.selectedSeedId : 'bell-pepper';
        this.growingContext = ['any','renter','balcony','indoor','yard','community'].includes(ui.growingContext) ? ui.growingContext : 'any';
        if (ui.actionForm && typeof ui.actionForm === 'object') {
          this.actionForm = { ...this.actionForm, ...ui.actionForm };
        }

        // Swaps
        this.swapsView = ui.swapsView || 'areas';
        this.swapsSearch = ui.swapsSearch || '';
        this.swapsFilter = ui.swapsFilter || '';
        this.swapsPriority = ui.swapsPriority || '';
        this.swapsSelectedArea = ui.swapsSelectedArea || null;
        this.swapsSelectedCategory = ui.swapsSelectedCategory || null;
        this.swapsSelectedItem = ui.swapsSelectedItem || null;

        // Item Guide
        this.itemGuideSearch = ui.itemGuideSearch || '';
        this.itemGuideArea = ui.itemGuideArea || '';
        this.itemGuideCategory = ui.itemGuideCategory || '';
        if (ui.itemGuideSelectedId) {
          this.itemGuideSelected = this.itemGuideItems.find(i => i.id === ui.itemGuideSelectedId) || null;
        } else {
          this.itemGuideSelected = null;
        }
      }

      // Rebuild derived state
      this.journeyDoneSet = new Set(this.journeyDone);
      this.computeSwapCounts();
      this.buildSearchIndexes();

    } catch (e) {
      console.warn('Zerra saved state is corrupted; resetting the saved state.', e);
      try { window.localStorage.removeItem('zerra-app'); } catch (_) {}
      this.persist();
    }
  } else {
    // No saved data – persist the default state
    this.persist();
  }
    },

    persist() {
  // Do not recreate saved data while a reset/reload is in progress.
  if (this._isResetting) return;

  const zerraApp = {
    schemaVersion: this.schemaVersion,
    savedAt: new Date().toISOString(),
    profile: { onboarded: true, path: this.profile.path },
    journeyDone: [...this.journeyDone],
    saved: [...this.saved],
    impact: [...this.impact],
    activity: [...this.activity],
    reflections: [...this.reflections],
    theme: this.theme,
    ui: {
      view: this.view,
      globalSearch: this.globalSearch,
      exploreSearch: this.exploreSearch,
      filters: { ...this.filters },
      disposalSearch: this.disposalSearch,
      journeyArea: this.journeyArea,
      impactFilter: this.impactFilter,
      actionForm: { ...this.actionForm },
      foodCycleSearch: this.foodCycleSearch,
      selectedSeedId: this.selectedSeedId,
      growingContext: this.growingContext,

      // Swaps & Alternatives full state
      swapsView: this.swapsView,
      swapsSearch: this.swapsSearch,
      swapsFilter: this.swapsFilter,
      swapsPriority: this.swapsPriority,
      swapsSelectedArea: this.swapsSelectedArea,
      swapsSelectedCategory: this.swapsSelectedCategory,
      swapsSelectedItem: this.swapsSelectedItem,

      // Item Guide full state
      itemGuideSearch: this.itemGuideSearch,
      itemGuideSelectedId: this.itemGuideSelected ? this.itemGuideSelected.id : null,
      itemGuideArea: this.itemGuideArea,
      itemGuideCategory: this.itemGuideCategory
    }
  };

  try {
    window.localStorage.setItem('zerra-app', JSON.stringify(zerraApp));
  } catch (e) {
    console.warn('Zerra could not save state to local storage.', e);
  }
    },


    finishOnboarding() {
      if (!['modern','balanced','earthbound'].includes(this.profile.path)) this.profile.path='balanced';
      this.profile.onboarded=true;
      this.persist();

    go(id) {
      if (!this.primaryNav.some(n => n.id === id) && !['saved','disposal','reconnect','food-soil','normalization'].includes(id)) return;
      this.view=id;
      this.persist();
      window.scrollTo({top:0,behavior:'smooth'});
    },

    navActive(id) {
      if (id === 'explore') return ['explore','disposal','reconnect','food-soil','normalization'].includes(this.view);
      if (id === 'impact') return ['impact','saved'].includes(this.view);
      return this.view === id;
    },

    openCollection(collection) {
      if (collection.route) {
        this.go(collection.route);
        return;
      }
      this.exploreSearch=collection.query || '';
      this.activeDiscoverCollection=collection.title;
      this.filters={category:'',path:'',difficulty:'',cost:'',time:'',sort:'relevance'};
      this.persist();
      this.$nextTick(() => {
        document.getElementById?.('discover-results')?.scrollIntoView({behavior:'smooth',block:'start'});

    selectedReconnectModule() {
      return this.reconnectModules.find(module => module.id === this.selectedReconnectId) || this.reconnectModules[0];
    },

    selectReconnect(id) {
      if (!this.reconnectModules.some(module => module.id === id)) return;
      this.selectedReconnectId = id;
      this.reflectionDraft = '';
      window.scrollTo({top:0,behavior:'smooth'});
    },

    runReconnectAction(module) {
      this.globalSearch = module.actionQuery || module.title;

    saveReflection(module) {
      const note = this.reflectionDraft.trim();
      if (!note) return;
      const entry = {id:'reflection-'+Date.now(),moduleId:module.id,moduleTitle:module.title,note:note.slice(0,1200),date:new Date().toISOString()};
      this.reflections.unshift(entry);
      this.activity.unshift({uid:'activity-'+entry.id,label:`Reflected: ${module.title}`,date:entry.date});

    deleteReflection(id) {
      this.reflections = this.reflections.filter(entry => entry.id !== id);

    filteredSeedProfiles() {
      const q = this.foodCycleSearch.trim().toLowerCase();
      if (!q) return this.seedProfiles;
      const terms = q.split(/\s+/).filter(Boolean);
      return this.seedProfiles.filter(profile => {
        const hay = `${profile.name} ${(profile.keywords||[]).join(' ')} ${profile.edible} ${profile.saveable} ${profile.compost}`.toLowerCase();
        return terms.every(term => hay.includes(term));
      });
    },

    selectedSeedProfile() {
      return this.seedProfiles.find(profile => profile.id === this.selectedSeedId) || this.filteredSeedProfiles()[0] || this.seedProfiles[0];
    },

    seedProfileForQuery(query) {
      const q = String(query || '').trim().toLowerCase();
      if (!q) return null;
      return this.seedProfiles.find(profile => profile.name.toLowerCase().includes(q) || (profile.keywords||[]).some(keyword => keyword.toLowerCase().includes(q) || q.includes(keyword.toLowerCase()))) || null;
    },

    goVeganContextForQuery(query) {

        {terms:['meat','beef','steak','hamburger','pork','bacon','ham','chicken','turkey','fish','seafood'],title:'Food from animals',detail:'Explore the living beings, ethics, nutrition, and plant-based alternatives behind animal-derived foods.'},
        {terms:['milk','dairy','cheese','butter','cream','yogurt','egg','mayonnaise','mayo','honey'],title:'Animal-derived ingredient',detail:'Find plant-based replacements, recipes, nutrition guidance, and the animal relationship behind this ingredient.'},
        {terms:['leather','wool','fur','silk','feather','down'],title:'Animal-derived material',detail:'Compare animal use, everyday products, and practical alternatives while Zerra handles care and end of life.'}
      ];

    logPhaseFourAction(type, note) {

      };

    pathName(id) {
      return this.paths.find(p=>p.id===id)?.name || 'Balanced';

    greeting() {
      const hour = new Date().getHours();
      const part = hour < 12 ? 'Good morning' : hour < 18 ? 'Good afternoon' : 'Good evening';
      return `${part}.`;
    },

    todayISO() {
      const d = new Date();
      const local = new Date(d.getTime() - d.getTimezoneOffset()*60000);
      return local.toISOString().slice(0,10);
    },

    todayFocus() {
      const path = this.profile.path;
      const preferred = {
        modern:['food-plan','buy-less','recycle-right'],
        balanced:['repair-first','compost-basics','grow-herbs'],
        earthbound:['soil-building','grow-herbs','seed-saving']
      }[path];
      const day = new Date().getDate();
      return this.exploreItems.find(i => i.id === preferred[day % preferred.length]) || this.exploreItems[0];
    },

    recommendations() {
      return [...this.exploreItems].sort((a,b)=>{
        const ap = a.paths.includes(this.profile.path) ? 30 : 0;
        const bp = b.paths.includes(this.profile.path) ? 30 : 0;
        return (b.relevance+bp)-(a.relevance+ap);
      });
    },

    filteredItemGuide() {
      const q=(this.itemGuideSearch||'').trim().toLowerCase();
      let rows=this.canonicalItemGuideItems || this.itemGuideItems;
      if (this.itemGuideArea) rows=rows.filter(i=>i.areaId===this.itemGuideArea);
      if (this.itemGuideCategory) rows=rows.filter(i=>i.categoryId===this.itemGuideCategory);
      if (!q) return rows.slice(0,80);
      const terms=q.split(/\s+/).filter(Boolean);
      return rows.filter(i => {
        const alternatives=i.swapItemId
          ? (this.swapAlternativesByItem[i.swapItemId] || [])
              .map(a=>`${a.name||''} ${a.description||''} ${a.type||''}`).join(' ')
          : '';
        const disposal=(i.disposalIds||[])
          .map(id=>this.disposalItems.find(d=>d.id===id))
          .filter(Boolean)
          .map(d=>`${d.name||d.item||''} ${d.note||''} ${(d.keywords||[]).join(' ')}`).join(' ');
        const hay=`${i.name||''} ${i.summary||''} ${i.area||''} ${i.category||''} ${(i.keywords||[]).join(' ')} ${alternatives} ${disposal}`.toLowerCase();
        return terms.every(term=>hay.includes(term));
      }).slice(0,80);
    },
    itemGuideCategories() {
      return this.itemGuideArea ? this.swapCategories.filter(c=>c.areaId===this.itemGuideArea) : this.swapCategories;
    },
    setItemGuideArea(id) {
      this.itemGuideArea=this.itemGuideArea===id ? '' : id;
      this.itemGuideCategory='';
      this.itemGuideSelected=null;
      this.persist();
    },
    setItemGuideCategory(id) {
      this.itemGuideCategory=this.itemGuideCategory===id ? '' : id;
      this.itemGuideSelected=null;
      this.persist();
    },
    clearItemGuideFilters() {
      this.itemGuideSearch=''; this.itemGuideArea=''; this.itemGuideCategory=''; this.itemGuideSelected=null;
      this.persist();
    },
    selectItemGuide(item) {
      this.itemGuideSelected=item;
      this.persist();
    },
    itemGuideAlternatives(item) { if(!item||!item.swapItemId)return []; return (this.swapAlternativesByItem[item.swapItemId] || []).sort((a,b)=>(a.priority||99)-(b.priority||99)); },
    itemGuideDisposal(item) { if(!item)return []; return (item.disposalIds||[]).map(id=>this.disposalItems.find(d=>d.id===id)).filter(Boolean); },

    groupedSearchResults() {
      const query = (this.swapsSearch || '').trim().toLowerCase();
      if (!query) return [];
      const cacheKey = `${query}|${this.swapsFilter}|${this.swapsPriority}`;
      if (cacheKey === this.groupedSearchCacheKey) return this.groupedSearchCacheRows;
      const terms = query.split(/\s+/).filter(Boolean);
      const match = text => terms.every(term => String(text || '').toLowerCase().includes(term));
      const groups = [
        {id:'items', label:'Items & everyday choices', rows:this.filteredSwapItems().slice(0,6), title:i=>i.name, detail:i=>i.description},
        {id:'guides', label:'Practical guides', rows:this.exploreItems.filter(i=>match(i._search)).slice(0,6), title:i=>i.title, detail:i=>i.summary},
        {id:'disposal', label:'Return & responsible disposal', rows:this.disposalItems.filter(i=>match(`${i.name} ${(i.keywords||[]).join(' ')} ${i.note||''}`)).slice(0,6), title:i=>i.name, detail:i=>i.note},
        {id:'seeds', label:'Food, seeds & soil', rows:this.seedProfiles.filter(i=>match(`${i.name} ${(i.keywords||[]).join(' ')} ${i.edible} ${i.saveable} ${i.compost}`)).slice(0,6), title:i=>i.name, detail:i=>i.saveable},
        {id:'reconnect', label:'Reconnect', rows:this.reconnectModules.filter(i=>match(`${i.title} ${i.opening} ${i.example} ${i.deeper}`)).slice(0,6), title:i=>i.title, detail:i=>i.opening},
        {id:'practices', label:'Practices', rows:this.journeySteps.filter(i=>match(i._search || `${i.title} ${i.summary} ${i.category}`)).slice(0,6), title:i=>i.title, detail:i=>i.summary}
      ];
      this.groupedSearchCacheKey = cacheKey;
      this.groupedSearchCacheRows = groups.filter(group=>group.rows.length);
      return this.groupedSearchCacheRows;
    },

    openKnowledgeResult(group, item) {
      if (group.id === 'items') { this.selectSwapItem(item.id); return; }
      if (group.id === 'guides' || group.id === 'practices') { this.openContent(item); return; }
      if (group.id === 'disposal') { this.disposalSearch=item.name; this.go('disposal'); return; }
      if (group.id === 'seeds') { this.openSeedFromSearch(item); return; }
      if (group.id === 'reconnect') { this.selectReconnect(item.id); this.go('reconnect'); }
    },

    searchEverything() {
      const q = (this.globalSearch || '').trim();
      if (!q) { this.exploreSearch=''; this.go('explore'); return; }
      const qLower = q.toLowerCase();
      const seedMatch = this.seedProfiles.find(profile =>
        profile.name.toLowerCase().includes(qLower) ||
        (profile.keywords || []).some(keyword => keyword.toLowerCase().includes(qLower) || qLower.includes(keyword.toLowerCase()))
      );
      if (seedMatch) {
        this.foodCycleSearch=q;
        this.selectedSeedId=seedMatch.id;
        this.persist();
        this.go('food-soil');
        return;
      }
      const itemMatches = this.itemGuideItems.some(i =>
        (i._search || `${i.name||''} ${i.summary||''} ${(i.keywords||[]).join(' ')}`.toLowerCase()).includes(qLower)
      );
      if (itemMatches) {
        this.itemGuideSearch=q;
        this.itemGuideSelected=null;
        this.persist();
        this.go('swaps');
        return;
      }
      this.exploreSearch=q;
      this.filters.category='';
      this.filters.path='';
      this.filters.difficulty='';
      this.filters.cost='';
      this.filters.time='';
      this.persist();
      this.go('explore');
    },

    filteredExplore() {
      const q = this.exploreSearch.trim().toLowerCase();
      let list = this.exploreItems.filter(i => {
        return (!q || i._search.includes(q))
          && (!this.filters.category || i.category === this.filters.category)
          && (!this.filters.path || i.paths.includes(this.filters.path))
          && (!this.filters.difficulty || i.difficulty === this.filters.difficulty)
          && (!this.filters.cost || i.cost === this.filters.cost)
          && (!this.filters.time || i.time === this.filters.time);
      });

      if (this.filters.sort === 'title') list.sort((a,b)=>a.title.localeCompare(b.title));
      else if (this.filters.sort === 'difficulty') {
        const rank={Easy:1,Moderate:2,Advanced:3};
        list.sort((a,b)=>rank[a.difficulty]-rank[b.difficulty]);
      } else {
        list.sort((a,b)=>{
          const ap=a.paths.includes(this.profile.path)?30:0;
          const bp=b.paths.includes(this.profile.path)?30:0;
          return (b.relevance+bp)-(a.relevance+ap);
        });
      }
      return list;
    },

    clearExploreFilters() {
      this.exploreSearch='';
      this.activeDiscoverCollection='';
      this.filters={category:'',path:'',difficulty:'',cost:'',time:'',sort:'relevance'};
      this.persist();
    },

    filteredDisposal() {
      const q=this.disposalSearch.trim().toLowerCase();
      if (!q) return this.disposalItems.slice(0,6);
      return this.disposalItems.filter(i =>
        i._name.includes(q) ||
        i._keywords.some(k=>k.includes(q) || q.includes(k))
      );
    },

    openContent(item) {
      this.activeContent = item;
      this.contentOpen = true;
    },

    isJourneyDone(id) { return this.journeyDoneSet.has(id); },

    toggleJourney(step) {
      if (this.isJourneyDone(step.id)) {
        this.journeyDone = this.journeyDone.filter(id=>id!==step.id);
      } else {
        this.journeyDone.push(step.id);
        this.activity.unshift({
          uid:'journey-'+step.id+'-'+Date.now(),
          label:`Completed: ${step.title}`,
          date:new Date().toISOString()
        });
      }
      this.journeyDoneSet = new Set(this.journeyDone);
      this.persist();
    },

    filteredJourney() {
      let list = this.journeyArea
        ? this.journeySteps.filter(s=>s.area===this.journeyArea)
        : this.journeySteps.filter(s=>s.paths.includes(this.profile.path));

      return [...list].sort((a,b)=>{
        const ad=this.isJourneyDone(a.id)?1:0;
        const bd=this.isJourneyDone(b.id)?1:0;
        return ad-bd;
      });
    },

    journeyAreaProgress(area) {
      const steps=this.journeySteps.filter(s=>s.area===area);
      const done=steps.filter(s=>this.isJourneyDone(s.id)).length;
      return {done,total:steps.length,percent:steps.length?Math.round(done/steps.length*100):0};
    },

    journeyCompletedCount() { return this.journeyDone.filter(id=>this.journeySteps.some(s=>s.id===id)).length; },

    journeyPercent() {
      return Math.round((this.journeyCompletedCount()/this.journeySteps.length)*100);
    },

    nextJourneyStep() {
      return this.journeySteps.find(s=>s.paths.includes(this.profile.path) && !this.isJourneyDone(s.id))
        || this.journeySteps.find(s=>!this.isJourneyDone(s.id))
        || null;
    },

    earthStage() {
      const p=this.journeyPercent();
      if (p < 15) return {name:'Seed',description:'A beginning: awareness, intention, and the first practical changes.'};
      if (p < 35) return {name:'Sprout',description:'New habits and skills are taking root.'};
      if (p < 60) return {name:'Garden',description:'Your knowledge is becoming a useful, connected practice.'};
      if (p < 85) return {name:'Habitat',description:'Repair, reuse, growing, sharing, and resource awareness are forming a broader system.'};
      return {name:'Thriving Ecosystem',description:'A diverse set of practical skills and habits now reinforce one another.'};
    },

    openChallenge(challenge) {
      this.activeChallenge=challenge;
      this.challengeOpen=true;
    },

    toggleSave(id,type) {
      const existing=this.saved.find(s=>s.id===id);
      if (existing) this.saved=this.saved.filter(s=>s.id!==id);
      else this.saved.unshift({id,type,date:new Date().toISOString()});
      this.persist();
    },

    isSaved(id) { return this.saved.some(s=>s.id===id); },

    savedItems() {
      return this.saved.map(s=>{
        let item =
          this.exploreItems.find(i=>i.id===s.id) ||
          this.journeySteps.find(i=>i.id===s.id) ||
          this.disposalItems.find(i=>i.id===s.id) ||
          this.challenges.find(i=>i.id===s.id) ||
          this.swapAlternatives.find(i=>i.id===s.id) ||
          this.swapItems.find(i=>i.id===s.id);
        if (item) {
          if (!item.title && item.name) item.title = item.name;
          if (!item.summary && item.description) item.summary = item.description;
          return {...item, savedType:s.type};
        }
        return null;
      }).filter(Boolean);
    },

    openSaved(entry) {
      if (entry.savedType==='disposal') {
        this.disposalSearch=entry.name;
        this.go('disposal');
      } else if (entry.savedType==='journey') {
        this.journeyArea=entry.area;
        this.go('journey');
      } else if (entry.savedType==='challenge') {
        this.openChallenge(entry);
      } else if (entry.savedType==='swap' || entry.savedType==='item') {
        let itemId = null;
        if (entry.savedType==='swap') {
          const alt = this.swapAlternatives.find(a=>a.id===entry.id);
          if (alt) itemId = alt.itemId;
        } else if (entry.savedType==='item') {
          itemId = entry.id;
        }
        if (itemId) {
          this.swapsSelectedItem = itemId;
          this.swapsView = 'alternatives';
          this.go('swaps');
        } else {
          const item = this.swapItems.find(i=>i.id===entry.id);
          if (item) {
            this.swapsSelectedItem = item.id;
            this.swapsView = 'alternatives';
            this.go('swaps');
          }
        }
      } else {
        this.openContent(entry);
      }
    },

    openActionLog() {
      this.actionForm={type:'',quantity:'',note:'',date:this.todayISO()};
      this.actionOpen=true;
    },

    saveAction() {
      if (!this.actionTypes.includes(this.actionForm.type) || !this.actionForm.date) return;
      const quantity = this.actionForm.quantity === '' ? '' : Math.max(0, Number(this.actionForm.quantity));
      const entry={
        id:'impact-'+Date.now(),
        type:this.actionForm.type,
        quantity:Number.isFinite(quantity) ? quantity : '',
        note:this.actionForm.note.slice(0,300),
        date:this.actionForm.date,
        createdAt:new Date().toISOString()
      };
      this.impact.unshift(entry);
      this.activity.unshift({
        uid:'activity-'+entry.id,
        label:`Logged: ${entry.type}`,
        date:new Date().toISOString()
      });
      this.persist();
      this.actionOpen=false;
    },

    deleteImpact(id) {
      if (!confirm('Delete this action record?')) return;
      this.impact=this.impact.filter(i=>i.id!==id);
      this.persist();
    },

    filteredImpact() {
      return this.impact
        .filter(i=>!this.impactFilter || i.type===this.impactFilter)
        .sort((a,b)=>new Date(b.date)-new Date(a.date));
    },

    impactThisMonth() {
      const now=new Date();
      return this.impact.filter(i=>{
        const d=new Date(i.date+'T12:00:00');
        return d.getMonth()===now.getMonth() && d.getFullYear()===now.getFullYear();
      }).length;
    },

    mostCommonAction() {
      if (!this.impact.length) return '—';
      const counts={};
      this.impact.forEach(i=>counts[i.type]=(counts[i.type]||0)+1);
      return Object.entries(counts).sort((a,b)=>b[1]-a[1])[0][0];
    },

    impactStats() {
      if (!this.impact.length) return [];
      const counts={};
      this.impact.forEach(i=>counts[i.type]=(counts[i.type]||0)+1);
      const max=Math.max(...Object.values(counts));
      return Object.entries(counts)
        .map(([type,count])=>({type,count,percent:Math.round(count/max*100)}))
        .sort((a,b)=>b.count-a.count);
    },

    recentActivity() {
      return [...this.activity].sort((a,b)=>new Date(b.date)-new Date(a.date));
    },

    formatDate(date) {
      if (!date) return '';
      const d = date.length===10 ? new Date(date+'T12:00:00') : new Date(date);
      return new Intl.DateTimeFormat(undefined,{month:'short',day:'numeric',year:'numeric'}).format(d);
    },

    resetData() {
      // Prevent pagehide/beforeunload/visibility watchers from saving the
      // current state again after it has been removed.
      this._isResetting = true;

      try {
        window.localStorage.removeItem('zerra-app');
      } catch (e) {
        console.warn('Zerra could not clear local storage.', e);
      }

      location.reload();
    },

    // ========== SWAPS METHODS ==========
    getSwapAreaName() {
      const area = this.swapAreas.find(a => a.id === this.swapsSelectedArea);
      return area ? area.name : '';
    },

    getSwapCategoryName() {
      const cat = this.swapCategories.find(c => c.id === this.swapsSelectedCategory);
      return cat ? cat.name : '';
    },

    getSwapItemName() {
      const item = this.swapItems.find(i => i.id === this.swapsSelectedItem);
      return item ? item.name : '';
    },

    getSwapItemDescription() {
      const item = this.swapItems.find(i => i.id === this.swapsSelectedItem);
      return item ? item.description : '';
    },

    selectSwapArea(id) {
      this.swapsSearch=''; this.swapsFilter=''; this.swapsPriority='';
      this.swapsSelectedArea = id;
      this.swapsSelectedCategory = null;
      this.swapsSelectedItem = null;
      this.swapsView = 'categories';
      this.persist();
    },

    selectSwapCategory(id) {
      this.swapsSearch=''; this.swapsFilter=''; this.swapsPriority='';
      this.swapsSelectedCategory = id;
      this.swapsSelectedItem = null;
      this.swapsView = 'items';
      this.persist();
    },

    selectSwapItem(id) {
      this.swapsSelectedItem = id;
      this.swapsView = 'alternatives';
      this.persist();
    },

    swapCategoriesForArea() {
      if (!this.swapsSelectedArea) return [];
      return this.swapCategories
        .filter(c => c.areaId === this.swapsSelectedArea)
        .map(c => {
          c.itemCount = this.swapItems.filter(i => i.categoryId === c.id).length;
          return c;
        });
    },

    swapItemsForCategory() {
      if (!this.swapsSelectedCategory) return [];
      return this.swapItems
        .filter(i => i.categoryId === this.swapsSelectedCategory)
        .map(i => {
          i.alternativeCount = (this.swapAlternativesByItem[i.id] || []).length;
          const cat = this.swapCategories.find(c => c.id === i.categoryId);
          i.categoryName = cat ? cat.name : '';
          return i;
        });
    },

    filteredSwapItems() {
      // Self-heal the lookup index before any filter-only search.
      // This prevents quick filters from returning zero when the UI renders before/without the performance index.
      if (!this.swapAlternativesByItem || Object.keys(this.swapAlternativesByItem).length===0) {
        this.swapAlternativesByItem={};
        this.swapAlternatives.forEach(a => {
          (this.swapAlternativesByItem[a.itemId] ||= []).push(a);
        });
      }
      const cacheKey=`${this.swapsSearch||''}|${this.swapsFilter||''}|${this.swapsPriority||''}`;
      if (cacheKey===this.swapFilterCacheKey) return this.swapFilterCacheRows;
      const q=(this.swapsSearch||'').trim().toLowerCase();
      let items=this.swapItems;

      if (q) {
        const terms=q.split(/\s+/).filter(Boolean);
        items=items.filter(i => {
          const alts=(this.swapAlternativesByItem[i.id] || []);
          const altText=alts.map(a=>`${a.name||''} ${a.description||''} ${a.type||''} ${(a.tags||[]).join(' ')}`).join(' ');
          const cat=this.swapCategories.find(c=>c.id===i.categoryId);
          const area=cat ? this.swapAreas.find(a=>a.id===cat.areaId) : null;
          const hay=`${i.name||''} ${i.description||''} ${(i.keywords||[]).join(' ')} ${(i.tags||[]).join(' ')} ${cat?.name||''} ${area?.name||''} ${altText}`.toLowerCase();
          return terms.every(term=>hay.includes(term));
        });
      }

      if (this.swapsFilter) {
        items=items.filter(i => {
          const aa=(this.swapAlternativesByItem[i.id] || []);
          switch(this.swapsFilter) {
            case 'free':
              return aa.some(a=>a.attrs?.upfrontCost==='Free' || (a.tags||[]).includes('No Purchase'));
            case 'lowcost':
              return aa.some(a=>['Free','Very Low','Low'].includes(a.attrs?.upfrontCost));
            case 'lowwaste':
              return aa.some(a=>['None','Very Low','Low'].includes(a.attrs?.wasteGeneration));
            case 'noplastic':
              return aa.some(a=>a.attrs?.plasticUse==='None' || (a.tags||[]).includes('Plastic-Free'));
            case 'longlife':
              return aa.some(a=>['High','Very High'].includes(a.attrs?.durability));
            case 'repairable':
              return aa.some(a=>['Yes','Highly Repairable'].includes(a.attrs?.repairability) || (a.tags||[]).includes('Repairable'));
            case 'diy':
              return aa.some(a=>(a.tags||[]).includes('DIY'));
            case 'secondhand':
              return aa.some(a=>(a.tags||[]).includes('Secondhand'));
            case 'traditional':
              return aa.some(a=>(a.tags||[]).includes('Traditional Practice'));
            default:return true;
          }
        });
      }

      items=items.map(i => {
        i.alternativeCount=(this.swapAlternativesByItem[i.id] || []).length;
        const cat=this.swapCategories.find(c=>c.id===i.categoryId);
        i.categoryName=cat ? cat.name : '';
        return i;
      });

      if (this.swapsPriority) {
        const scoreItem=i => {
          const aa=(this.swapAlternativesByItem[i.id] || []);
          const tests={
            'save-money':a=>['Free','Very Low','Low'].includes(a.attrs?.upfrontCost),
            'reduce-waste':a=>['None','Very Low','Low'].includes(a.attrs?.wasteGeneration),
            'avoid-plastic':a=>a.attrs?.plasticUse==='None',
            'long-life':a=>['High','Very High'].includes(a.attrs?.durability),
            'diy':a=>(a.tags||[]).includes('DIY'),
            'no-purchase':a=>(a.tags||[]).includes('No Purchase') || a.attrs?.upfrontCost==='Free',
            'repairable':a=>['Yes','Highly Repairable'].includes(a.attrs?.repairability),
            'low-maintenance':a=>/simple|low.?maintenance|washable|durable/i.test(`${a.name||''} ${a.description||''}`)
          };
          const test=tests[this.swapsPriority];
          return test ? aa.filter(test).length : 0;
        };
        items=items.map(i=>({i,s:scoreItem(i)})).filter(x=>x.s>0).sort((a,b)=>b.s-a.s).map(x=>x.i);
      }
      this.swapFilterCacheKey=cacheKey;
      this.swapFilterCacheRows=items;
      return items;
    },

    sortedSwapAlternatives() {
      const itemId = this.swapsSelectedItem;
      if (!itemId) return [];
      let alts = this.swapAlternatives.filter(a => a.itemId === itemId);

      if (this.swapsPriority) {
        const order = {
          'save-money': (a) => { const cost = a.attrs.upfrontCost || 'Moderate'; const map = { 'Free':0,'Very Low':1,'Low':2,'Moderate':3,'High':4,'Very High':5 }; return map[cost] || 3; },
          'reduce-waste': (a) => { const waste = a.attrs.wasteGeneration || 'Moderate'; const map = { 'None':0,'Very Low':1,'Low':2,'Moderate':3,'High':4,'Very High':5 }; return map[waste] || 3; },
          'avoid-plastic': (a) => { const plastic = a.attrs.plasticUse || 'Moderate'; const map = { 'None':0,'Minimal':1,'Moderate':2,'High':3,'Very High':4 }; return map[plastic] || 2; },
          'long-life': (a) => { const dur = a.attrs.durability || 'Medium'; const map = { 'Very Low':0,'Low':1,'Medium':2,'High':3,'Very High':4 }; return -(map[dur] || 2); },
          'convenience': (a) => { const conv = a.attrs.convenience || 'Medium'; const map = { 'Very Low':0,'Low':1,'Medium':2,'High':3,'Very High':4 }; return -(map[conv] || 2); },
          'natural': (a) => { const nat = a.attrs.naturalMaterial || 'Some'; const map = { 'None':0,'Some':1,'Mostly':2,'All':3 }; return -(map[nat] || 1); },
          'diy': (a) => a.tags.includes('DIY') ? 0 : 1,
          'no-purchase': (a) => { const cost = a.attrs.upfrontCost || 'Moderate'; return cost === 'Free' ? 0 : 1; },
          'repairable': (a) => { const rep = a.attrs.repairability || 'No'; const map = { 'No':0,'Limited':1,'Yes':2,'Highly Repairable':3 }; return -(map[rep] || 0); },
          'low-maintenance': (a) => { const maint = a.attrs.maintenance || 'Moderate'; const map = { 'None':0,'Very Low':1,'Low':2,'Moderate':3,'High':4 }; return map[maint] || 3; }
        };
        const sortFn = order[this.swapsPriority];
        if (sortFn) {
          alts.sort((a,b) => sortFn(a) - sortFn(b));
        }
      } else {
        const typeOrder = { 'Use Existing':0, 'Use Less':1, 'Go Without':2, 'Maintain':3, 'Repair':4, 'Reuse':5, 'Repurpose':6, 'DIY':7, 'Refillable':8, 'Reusable':9, 'Secondhand':10, 'Natural Material':11, 'Traditional Practice':12, 'Modern Alternative':13, 'Lower-Waste Conventional':14, 'Lifestyle Change':15, 'System Change':16 };
        const evidenceOrder = { 'Well established':0, 'Supported':1, 'Mixed/Context-dependent':2, 'Traditional use':3, 'Limited evidence':4 };
        alts.sort((a,b) => {
          const ta = typeOrder[a.type] || 99;
          const tb = typeOrder[b.type] || 99;
          if (ta !== tb) return ta - tb;
          const ea = evidenceOrder[a.evidence] || 5;
          const eb = evidenceOrder[b.evidence] || 5;
          return ea - eb;
        });
      }

      return alts;
    },

    clearSwapsSearch() {
      this.swapsSearch = '';
      this.swapsFilter = '';
      this.swapsPriority = '';
      this.swapsLastSearch = '';
      this.swapFilterCacheKey = null;
      this.swapFilterCacheRows = [];
      this.swapsView = 'areas';
      this.swapsSelectedArea = null;
      this.swapsSelectedCategory = null;
      this.swapsSelectedItem = null;
      this.persist();
    }
  };
}

window.zerraApp = zerraApp;
